content.ascii:
Diagram
|-- Repository-independent immutable value
|   |-- readonly diagramId: string; readonly revisionId: string
|   |   `-- Service identity stays stable while the issued revision identifies content state.
|   |-- readonly id: string; readonly revision: number
|   |   `-- The local id keys canvas content; revision is a nonnegative integer.
|   `-- Canvas, persistence and agents share the value; writers use DiagramService.
|-- Canonical content
|   |-- content: DeepReadonly<DiagramContent>
|   |-- buildDiagramContent(ascii, revisionId, kind, parserVersion)
|   |   |-- Accepts printable ASCII with LF and at most 20000 characters.
|   |   `-- structure: { kind: 'diagram' } | { kind: 'tree', ... }
|   |-- Tree parsing creates revision-and-hash-specific node identities.
|   |   `-- DiagramContentNode: parentId?, childIds, foldRanges, line, startColumn, endColumn
|   `-- visibleContentLines(content, collapsedIds)
|       `-- Requires fold ranges; unknown collapsed IDs raise STALE_CONTENT_NODE.
|-- Source context and evidence
|   |-- sourceContext: DeepReadonly<DiagramSourceContext>
|   |-- binding?: DiagramSourceBinding; contentHash: string
|   |   `-- A binding identifies the source, repository, corpus and domain profile.
|   |-- mappings: readonly DiagramElementMapping[]; evidence: Record<...>
|   |   `-- Mappings reference evidence entities and indexed source ranges.
|   `-- Evidence ranges retain original lines and repository-relative paths.
|-- Validation and derived queries
|   |-- validateDiagram(diagram)
|   |   |-- Rebuilds canonical content and verifies its source hash.
|   |   `-- Checks identities, jumps, local mappings and evidence joins.
|   |-- diagramSource(diagram)
|   |   `-- Calls queryDiagramSourceContext for read-only derived joins.
|   `-- forSelection(rect); entries(); search(query)
|       `-- Need mappings and evidence; search also examines labels, paths and symbols.
`-- Links and instance presentation
    |-- jumps?: DeepReadonly<DiagramJump[]>
    |   `-- Link validation requires the associated DiagramContent.
    `-- Collapse choices live in canvas.diagramViews per display instance.
        `-- The controller remaps those choices when patching content.
